# Cenotes Homún — llms.txt
# https://cenoteshomun.com

> Local tour operator in Homún, Yucatán, Mexico. Cenote tours, ATV adventures and day trips
> across the Yucatán Peninsula for international and domestic travelers.
> Tour operador local en Homún, Yucatán, México.

## Languages / Idiomas
- English: https://cenoteshomun.com/en.html — prices in USD
- Español: https://cenoteshomun.com/ — precios en MXN

## Tours and prices (USD, English site)

### Homún, Yucatán — 1 hour from Mérida
- Cenote Santa Rosa — $19 USD/person
- Cenote Santa Bárbara — $35 USD/person
- Santa Cruz Cenotes (Hacienda tour) — $36 USD/person
- Santa Cruz Cenotes + ATV — $55 USD/person

### Tulum, Quintana Roo
- Cenotes Casa Tortuga — $45 USD/person
- Casa Tortuga Silver — $59 USD/person
- Casa Tortuga Gold — $99 USD/person
- Off Road + Casa Tortuga — $105 USD/person

### Cancún and Puerto Morelos
- Isla Mujeres Catamaran (all inclusive) — $95 USD/person, kids $45 USD
- Shared ATV Off Road, Puerto Morelos — $79 USD/person
- Single ATV + Horseback Riding — $105 USD/person

## Booking and payment
- Booking is done via WhatsApp: +52 999 410 5737
- No prepayment required. Travelers pay cash on arrival.
- Cash accepted in US dollars or Mexican pesos.
- Refund policy: https://cenoteshomun.com/politica-reembolsos.html

## Useful for travelers
- Getting to Homún from Mérida: https://cenoteshomun.com/getting-there.html
- Cenotes guide: https://cenoteshomun.com/cenotes-guide-homun.html
- Homún is about 1 hour by car from Mérida, 3.5 hours from Cancún.
- Water temperature in cenotes stays around 75-79 F (24-26 C) year-round.

## Contact
- WhatsApp: +52 999 410 5737
- Web: https://cenoteshomun.com
